name: actuator_equivalent_v1
limits: Preserve per-joint effort and velocity limits from fixed baseline URDF; never scale with morphology automatically
notes: PD damping is separate from passive viscous friction.
Newton MJWarp has no separate kinetic joint friction property; dynamic_friction must remain zero.
Dry friction is a soft solver constraint and may creep; it is not an exact static lock.
New dry friction 0.003 N m and passive damping 0.01 N m s/rad are test priors, not measured motor values.
Preserve existing PD and armature values for a controlled comparison. No thermal, electrical, gear backlash, or torque-speed curve model is claimed.
